content.title: About
content.content: Flour taco shells are thin, crispy shells made from enriched wheat flour, water, salt, and vegetable oil. They are designed for quick preparation of tacos, burritos, and other Mexican dishes. The shell has a mild, neutral flavor that highlights the fillings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Flour tortillas became popular in the United States in the early 20th century as a cheaper alternative to corn shells.
Traditionally they are formed as 10‑12 cm diameter circles and fried until golden.
Flour shells soften faster in the microwave than corn shells, making them easier to use.
They are often called “flour taco shell” to distinguish them from “corn taco shell.”
Whole‑grain versions add a nuttier taste and extra fiber.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Provides a quick source of energy thanks to easily digestible carbs.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Enriched flour supplies iron, important for blood formation.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Includes thiamine, riboflavin, and niacin, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Compared with corn shells, flour shells usually contain less fat when no extra oil is added.

items.title: Versatile flavor
items.content: Neutral taste makes it suitable for a wide range of diets, including vegetarian and gluten‑free (when made with gluten‑free flour).

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: Contains gluten, so it is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Rapid carbohydrate absorption can raise blood sugar, which is important for diabetics.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some brands add salt; choose low‑sodium versions if you monitor sodium intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Warm the shell briefly in the oven, microwave, or skillet, then fill with meat, fish, beans, vegetables, cheese, and sauces. It also works well for casseroles, chips, and mini‑pizzas.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a sealed package. After opening, use within 1‑2 weeks. For longer storage keep in the refrigerator, but keep moisture out to prevent softening.
